source_snapshot.title: UAE weather forecast: Rain for the next four days, with temperatures dropping to the high-20s midweek
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: A light sweater and umbrella may become part of your daily ensemble this week, as the National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) expects rainfall over the next few days, along with decreasing temperatures on Thursday. The NCM forecasts fair to partly cloudy weather today, with a chance of convective cloud formation over some eastern and northern areas, such as Kalba and Dibba Al Fujairah, bringing rainfall. Scattered showers are expected to continue in various regions of the UAE over the next four days, with Thursday drawing the mercury lower in the daytime, into the high-20s, and minimum temperatures falling to 18°C in places like Ras Al Khaimah. Temperatures in the low-30s Meanwhile, temperatures are in the low-30s across the UAE today. Abu Dhabi and Dubai will peak at 33°C, while Sharjah, Ajman, and Ras Al Khaimah will reach 32°C. Umm Al Quwain will experience 31°C weather, with Fujairah topping out at 29°C. Moderate sea conditions Humidity is set to increase by night and on Tuesday morning over some western areas with a probability of fog or mist formation. In dense fog, the NCM cautions motorists to drive carefully, as visibility may drop considerably. The seas are calm today, with both the Arabian Gulf and Sea of Oman exhibiting slight conditions. This means you can expect gentle waves reaching up to two feet on-shore and up to three feet off-shore, along both eastern and western coasts. title: UAE weather forecast: Rain for the next four days, with temperatures dropping to the high-20s midweek
summary_ru: 🌧 Прогноз погоды в ОАЭ: дождь и похолодание На ближайшие четыре дня в ОАЭ ожидаются дожди, сообщает Национальный центр метеорологии. Температура в четверг опустится до высоких 20°C, минимальная температура в некоторых районах, например в Рас-эль-Хайме, может достигать 18°C. Сегодня температура в Дубае и Абу-Даби достигнет 33°C, в Фуджейре — 29°C. Ветер и море будут спокойными, возможен туман в западных районах, водителям рекомендуется соблюдать осторожность.
